description: Get one claim by id (HE-CLAIM-001) or slug: the statement, what it rests on, its structured sources, and — always present — what it does NOT establish and the observation that would retire it. Use this to cite the corpus honestly, or to check whether a result you have just measured confirms or falsifies a claim it makes.
